metadata.description: CellCog for Claude: brief finished work (videos, images, PDFs, decks, research, spreadsheets, apps) to an AI agent from inside your Claude session and get the files back as links. Connects with your own CellCog account through the remote MCP server at https://cellcog.ai/mcp.
